capabilities: Download external images embedded in Markdown image links
Load cached copies of images when offline or on other devices
Store the cache in the plugin folder so it syncs with the vault
Delete cached images from the settings
extras: Warns that caching on several devices between synchronizations can cause sync conflicts, and that the cache is intentionally excluded from Git-based syncing via a .gitignore; also notes cached images are not removed until the note is reopened after disabling the plugin.
problem: Obsidian's built-in browser cache for embedded external images lives outside the vault, so images must be re-downloaded on another device and fail to load when offline.
summary: Downloads and caches external images embedded in notes inside the vault so they load offline and on synced copies.
